text: Take a few moments and settle into a comfortable position.
Let your eyes close gently.
Take a slow breath in and an easy breath out.
Allow your awareness to arrive here.
Feel the natural rhythm of your breathing.
Feel the gentle rise and the soft release.
With each breath, the body begins to settle.
The nervous system receives the signal that this moment is safe, steady and supportive.
Let your attention move to the top of the head.
Down through the forehead.
Around the eyes.
Across the cheeks and jaw.
The muscles of the face soften.
The expression becomes neutral and at ease.
Awareness continues to move downward.
Into the neck and shoulders.
They rest naturally, supported by gravity and breath.
The arms feel heavy and relaxed.
All the way down into the hands and fingers.
Each breath brings a deeper sense of grounding.
Now bring attention into the center of the chest.
The space around the heart.
A quiet openness.
From this place, let your awareness move gently into the stomach and midsection.
The breath moving freely.
The body responds naturally.
Down through the hips.
Into the legs
All the way to the feet
The entire body is present
Supported
At ease
From this settled place, allow yourself to set a simple intention for this session
Not a task
Not a goal
A quality
Clarity
Or a quality of the body
Steadiness
That feels most supportive for today
Let it rest quietly in your awareness
Now imagine the mind becoming clear and spacious
Like a calm sky after morning light appears
Thoughts may still arise
They pass easily without pulling attention away
What remains is a steady sense of awareness
Clear
Centered
Available
This clarity is not forced
It emerges naturally as the body settles and the breath deepens
From this clear state
Begin to sense the day ahead
Not in detail
Just the feeling of being present within it
There is space between moments
Room to respond rather than react
Your awareness stays centered as experiences move around you
You remain steady within motion
This is clarity in action
Quiet confidence in motion
Allow this sense of steadiness to deepen
Simply present
Simply Present, a calm inner orientation that remains
With you as the day unfolds.
Take a moment to feel gratitude for this pause.
For choosing to begin your day from awareness rather than momentum.
This clarity stays accessible.
Return to it with a breath, with a pause, with attention.
Begin to bring awareness back into the body.
Feel the support beneath you.
Feel the gentle rhythm of breath.
Wiggle the fingers and toes softly.
When you're ready, let the eyes open.
Carry this steadiness with you and let it shape the way you move through the day.
